seeds.vh-3-2-0-0: On the ninth barley tier, old Miller Bram offers a midnight tutorial in wind-whistles while your bronze clapper grows heavy and cold.
seeds.vh-3-2-0-1: Beneath the skeletal arms of Mill Six, miller Thrum bargains a day of your youth for the secret grammar of gale-notes.
seeds.vh-3-2-1-0: Stumbling past frost-rimed hopper stones, you trade precious hours for a Miller's lesson while Biscuit chews salted straw in the dark.
seeds.vh-3-2-1-1: Amid grinding gears that hum like trapped hornets, miller Jael demands twenty-four hours of your schedule to teach the high-altitude whistle.
seeds.vh-3-2-1-2: A gaunt miller named Cribb blocks the stone stair, offering the craft of wind-calls in exchange for a day spent turning his sluggish millstone.
seeds.vh-3-2-1-3: Shivering in the draughty flour-loft, you weigh the cost of a miller's nocturnal schooling against the rapidly shrinking span of your twenty-day journey.
seeds.vh-3-2-1-4: Recognized by the rope-knot carved on your pack, a friendly knot-master steers you past the miller's time-trap onto an untaxed winch-slide.
seeds.vh-3-2-1-5: Rejecting the miller's bargain of stolen time, you slip down a sheer grain-chute while the bronze clapper hums a warning against the frost.
seeds.vh-3-2-2-0: Emerging from the miller's loft minus a day, you find the stone steps glazed with rime and the valley mist rolling upward.
seeds.vh-3-2-2-1: A frozen water-wheel groans beside the path, its dripping paddles forming crystal spears that threaten the strap of your bronze burden.
seeds.vh-3-2-2-2: Miller Korr hawks phlegm into the barley bin, warning you that the glacier ladders ahead are already snapping in the night freeze.
seeds.vh-3-2-2-3: You dodge a falling sack of damp middlings as two terrace boys wrestle near the cliff edge over a stolen pewter spoon.
seeds.vh-3-2-2-4: The bronze clapper strikes a resonant note against a low stone lintel, drawing suspicious stares from weavers mending wind-nets.
seeds.vh-3-2-2-5: A solitary guard from the Cable Court sits on a nail-keg, demanding an inspection fee for the bronze mass strapped to your tired shoulders.
seeds.vh-3-2-2-6: You share a wedge of hard goat cheese with an exhausted fog-warden whose lantern flickers against the encroaching white wall.
seeds.vh-3-2-2-7: Frost crystals bloom across your leather boots as the stone track narrows between a sheer cliff and an unrailed drop of six hundred feet.
seeds.vh-3-2-2-8: A rusted iron bell-pull hangs beside a boarded hatchway, twitching as though an unseen hand underground is trying to ring for help.
seeds.vh-3-2-2-9: Guided by your guild-wrapped hemp cord, the terrace toll-keeper waves you past the barrier without demanding your last copper coin.
seeds.vh-3-2-2-10: Biscuit digs his hooves into the frosted shale, refusing to pass a smoking charcoal brazier tended by shivering barley-scavengers.
seeds.vh-3-2-2-11: A flurry of dry snow scours the terrace wall, stinging your cheeks and plastering your coat with frozen dust from the threshing floor.
seeds.vh-3-2-2-12: You pry a loose horseshoe from frozen mud, slipping the iron relic into your pocket as a minor talisman against mountain misfortune.
seeds.vh-3-2-2-13: An old woman huddles beneath a woollen shawl, muttering ancient weather-rhymes about the thirteen steps and the impending closure of Lowgate.
seeds.vh-3-2-2-14: The wind shifts sharply from the north, carrying the metallic tang of distant foundry smoke and the sharp yelp of a mountain fox.
seeds.vh-3-2-2-15: You adjust the slipping canvas cradle of the clapper, feeling the dead bronze thrum in rhythm with your own tired heartbeat.
seeds.vh-3-2-3-0: Crossing a rickety cedar bridge over a gorge of grey mist, you hear the timbers groan under the combined weight of you and Biscuit.
seeds.vh-3-2-3-1: A tattered scarecrow stuffed with oat-straw points a crooked wooden finger toward the precipitous drop where the ladder-path begins.
seeds.vh-3-2-3-2: Miller Sedge hurls a handful of dry chaff into the wind to test the draft, narrowly missing your pack and the humming bronze tongue.
seeds.vh-3-2-3-3: You shelter behind a dry-stone retaining wall while a sudden squall of ice-pellets rattles against the heavy bronze clapper like buckshot.
seeds.vh-3-2-3-4: A Cable Court clerk offers a predatory credit token for your mule's shoes, promising safe transit down the remaining cliffs for half your rations.
seeds.vh-3-2-3-5: Two fog-wardens pass you in the white gloom, their synchronized hand-bells ringing a mournful three-beat cadence to warn of the ice edge.
seeds.vh-3-2-3-6: The stone path gives way to a slick sheet of blue glacier-run, forcing you to inch forward with your heels locked against the granite.
seeds.vh-3-2-3-7: A stray mountain goat watches from a high ledge, its amber eyes bright and indifferent to your struggle with the heavy metal load.
seeds.vh-3-2-3-8: You find a discarded tinker's hammer frozen in a puddle, its wooden handle splintered by frost-expansion but the iron head still sound.
seeds.vh-3-2-3-9: The bronze clapper emits a sudden, low-pitched thrum that makes the loose pebbles at your feet dance in tiny concentric circles.
seeds.vh-3-2-3-10: A low stone shrine to the Mountain Mother holds three tallow candles guttering in the wind, their flames shielded by cracked slate tiles.
seeds.vh-3-2-3-11: Biscuit brays a harsh, echoing challenge into the canyon, startling a flock of white-feathered choughs from the sheer cliff face.
seeds.vh-3-2-3-12: You scrape crusted mud and barley hulls from your boot treads, shivering as the damp mountain air seeps through your woven wool tunic.
seeds.vh-3-2-3-13: Following Biscuit's canny instinct down a mule-track blocked to humans, you bypass a dangerous ice-slide and gain an hour of precious daylight.
seeds.vh-3-2-3-14: A rusted iron wind-vane shaped like a leaping trout spins erratically on its spindle, squeaking a dry warning of the storm still to come.
seeds.vh-3-2-3-15: You press your palm against the icy terrace retaining wall, feeling the ancient mortar vibrate with the underground hum of the falling mountain.
seeds.vh-3-2-4-0: The wind-mills fall silent behind you one by one, their wooden sails lashed fast with hemp rope against the coming mountain gale.
seeds.vh-3-2-4-1: A solitary iron milestone hammered into the cliffside marks the final boundary of the barley terraces and the start of the vertical ice.
seeds.vh-3-2-4-2: You tighten the leather harness across your chest, ensuring the heavy clapper cannot shift as you prepare for the steep descent ahead.
seeds.vh-3-2-4-3: The fog clears for a heartbeat, revealing the dizzying drop to the glacier ladders where iron rungs frost over in the gathering dusk.
seeds.vh-3-2-4-4: A nervous ropewright checks the anchor-bolts on the final terrace gate, warning you that the iron rungs below are glazed with black ice.
seeds.vh-3-2-4-5: You share a final draught of cold water from your iron flask with Biscuit, patting his dusty grey neck before the stairs run out.
seeds.vh-3-2-4-6: The last miller of the tier hands you an iron piton for the ladders, muttering a dry blessing for your journey down to Lowgate.
seeds.vh-3-2-4-7: You step past the stone threshold of the lowest terrace gate, leaving the whispered wind-calls of the millers behind in the freezing air.
seeds.vh-3-2-5-0: The stone stairs terminate abruptly at a sheer drop of blue-white ice where the first great ladder swings in the mountain draft.
seeds.vh-3-2-5-1: Gripping the frozen iron rungs of the uppermost glacier ladder, you feel the bronze clapper pull your weight backward into the abyss.
seeds.vh-3-2-5-2: Below your dangling boots, the cloud sea churns like curdled milk, hiding the distant roofs of Lowgate while the wind rises to a scream.
seeds.vh-3-2-5-3: With Biscuit tethered securely to your belt-chain, you take the first downward step onto the swaying rungs of the vertical world.
seeds.vh-d-3-2: Traded away all your daylight hours to master every miller's whistle until the mountain pass froze shut forever, entombing you and the clapper in silent ice.
